==Sorting==
I am somewhat disturbed over the sorting on this page. Traditionally in our world it is sorted via their surname, but fact is that in these books they are foremost named by their firstname so it would be more logical that the page is sorted that way too.

The interest in their surnames are only secondary to the rest of their stories and connections.

Whenever I try to find a character I have to look through the whole list to find her as the only names always mentioned are their firstname, unless I am lucky and she is within the first section of the names.

I was going to change it myself, but I would like to hear opinions about it first.

----
Lima - 2nd December 2012

:See [[Category talk:People|here]] and the [[Category talk:People/Archive|archive]]. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 22:58, December 2, 2012 (UTC)
